description:
Split from fz-xxd.16. A c_pointer is the raw FILE* word passed to C externs; a c_pointer-typed clause accepts any integer. fz-xxd.16 gives pid and ref their own runtime kinds; c_pointer was left as is by its spike because three resource sites assume an integer payload: resource_payload_ref, the drain_destructors assert, and the 't: integer | c_pointer' parameter on make_resource/claim_resource (spike notes, scratchpad/xxd16/tagged_opaques_spike.patch report).
Fails before, passes after: a c_pointer-typed clause refuses an integer and admits a pointer returned by a C extern, on all three paths; file resources still close via their destructor.
Acceptance: full gate green; no pin rises unexplained.
title: A c_pointer type test tells a C pointer from every other value
